description: Canonical PostCircECD v2.0 Protocol Manifest with Europe PMC & ClinicalTrials.gov Primary Evidence Grounding

evidenceItems.title: Dorsal and ventral stream visuoperceptual processing deficits in Lewy body disease.
evidenceItems.sampleDescription: n = 53 LBD (asymptomatic to dementia) vs. n = 29 AD
evidenceItems.keyFindingSummary: LBD exhibits comparable ventral AND dorsal stream impairments, whereas ventral performance is relatively preserved compared to dorsal in AD. Visuoperceptual deficits in LBD explain a major share of variance on visually presented attention/executive tests, validating Visual-vs-Auditory De-Confounding (S5.1 vs. S5.3).

evidenceItems.title: Minor hallucinations as an early marker to differentiate dementia with Lewy bodies from Alzheimer's disease.
evidenceItems.sampleDescription: N = 121 mild stage (GDS 3-4), biomarker-supported (60 AD, 61 DLB)
evidenceItems.keyFindingSummary: In mild stages where global cognition, executive, and language scores overlap, episodic memory is more impaired in AD across all recall measures, while Pareidolia Test responses and minor hallucinations (54.1% in DLB vs. 13.3% in AD) show the highest discriminative accuracy for early DLB.

evidenceItems.title: Neuropsychological Profile and Cognitive Trajectories of Patients With Biomarker Evidence of Alzheimer Disease or Dementia With Lewy bodies.
evidenceItems.sampleDescription: N = 350 memory clinic patients with CSF/plasma p-tau217 & alpha-synuclein biomarkers
evidenceItems.keyFindingSummary: AD declines more steeply than pure DLB in memory (beta = 0.184, p < 0.01) and language (beta = 0.206, p < 0.01), whereas alpha-synuclein co-pathology drives steeper visual attention/processing speed, constructional praxis, and ideomotor apraxia deficits.

evidenceItems.title: Automated Speech Analysis to Identify Clinical, Anatomical, and Pathological Variants of Primary Progressive Aphasia.
evidenceItems.sampleDescription: N = 214 (43 controls, 50 nfvPPA, 56 lvPPA, 65 svPPA; 64 autopsy-confirmed) + 2-site external validation
evidenceItems.keyFindingSummary: From a 1-2 minute picture description recording, 4-8 acoustic/linguistic features per variant achieved AUC = 0.90 (95% CI: 0.83-0.97) in external validation and correlated with left posterior temporal cortex & angular gyrus atrophy in lvPPA.

evidenceItems.title: Artificial intelligence-based speech error detection to differentiate primary progressive aphasia variants.
evidenceItems.keyFindingSummary: Confirms F8 safeguard: off-the-shelf ASR fails to detect PPA speech errors because it prioritizes fluent transcription. Preserving raw audio + word/phoneme pause and repetition markers separates PPA variants from controls (p < 0.006, AUC = 0.798).

evidenceItems.title: Posterior Cortical Atrophy Diagnostic Delay & Simultanagnosia Compound-Figure Disintegration (with PMID: 40881893).
evidenceItems.sampleDescription: Clinical PCA case-series & hierarchical perceptual analyses
evidenceItems.keyFindingSummary: Documents how routine cognitive screens miss early PCA simultanagnosia and how compound hierarchical figures (Navon global/local + crowded scenes) unmask dorsal visual synthesis breakdown despite normal visual acuity.

evidenceItems.title: Anatomical Dissociation of Ventral Face Identity Perception, Familiarity, and Left Temporal Proper-Name Retrieval.
evidenceItems.sampleDescription: Multi-stage face recognition, semantic familiarity, and proper-name retrieval cohorts
evidenceItems.keyFindingSummary: Validates the 3-step Famous-Face Cascade (S5.2) separating ventral visual face-identity apperceptive failure from anterior temporal semantic loss and left temporal-pole/ILF proper-name tip-of-the-tongue retrieval failure.

evidenceItems.title: Primary Care Detection of Cognitive Impairment Leveraging Health & Consumer Technologies in Underserved Communities: The MyCog Trial.
evidenceItems.keyFindingSummary: Pragmatic primary-care trial of the 2-task MyCog baseline (DCCS + Picture Sequence Memory), motivating PostCircECD's posterior-cortical, pareidolia, language, and modality-deconfounded extensions.
